videos.script:
A test is a program that remembers what the planner was supposed to do. {{vitest}} The first ones are about weeks, the oldest code in the planner, and they run in a fraction of a second.

Then a test earns its keep. {{failing}} You will break one small comparison, on purpose, and watch a test say exactly what went wrong.

Then the planner class, {{runes}} tested with no component and no browser, and a component rendered to HTML inside a test. {{render}}

Then the whole planner, in a real browser. {{playwright}} Five tests, and two of them with JavaScript switched off, so that lesson fourteen's promise is checked on every run from now on.

And last, {{what}} what is worth testing, and one command that runs every check the planner has.
